section_summary: This section contains State Department and consular reports on Japanese merchant vessel movements from December 1940 to January 1941, together with paraphrases sent to the Navy. It also records questions about which movements to report and whether consular reports should continue alongside those of naval attachés. The opening pages are a continuing list of papers that includes later July 1941 entries.

people.name: John G. McGurk
people.role: American chargé d’affaires ad interim at Lima

people.name: A. H. McCollum
people.role: Lieutenant commander, Office of Naval Intelligence

people.name: Howard Bode
people.role: Navy captain, Office of the Chief of Naval Operations

subfiles.title: List of papers: Japanese merchant vessel movements
subfiles.about: Indexes reports and correspondence on Japanese vessel movements, chiefly July 1941.
subfiles.summary: Continuing list of papers with numbered entries and brief descriptions.

subfiles.title: Bombay inquiry on published sailing schedules
subfiles.about: Asks whether advertised Japanese sailing schedules should be telegraphed or only actual departures reported.
subfiles.summary: Bombay newspapers advertise Nippon Yusen Kaisha and Osaka Shosen sailings; Donovan requests guidance.

subfiles.title: Reply to Bombay on sailing reports
subfiles.about: Directs Bombay to report imminent or actual departures rather than published schedules.
subfiles.summary: The Department requests reports on individual vessel departures from public sources.

subfiles.title: Circular telegram forwarded to Panama
subfiles.about: Forwards a circular seeking vessel information for the Navy Department.
subfiles.summary: Cover letter encloses the December 17 circular sent to other American missions in the republics.

subfiles.title: TAKAOKA MARU at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports TAKAOKA MARU arriving at Callao and its expected southbound voyage.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Los Angeles, possibly via Salaverry, and was expected to sail for Valparaíso via Mollendo.

subfiles.title: TAKAOKA MARU report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Lima report on TAKAOKA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its Callao arrival and expected passage toward Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU at Guayaquil
subfiles.about: Reports NORWAY MARU arriving at Guayaquil and leaving for southern ports.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived December 21 and was to depart that evening.

subfiles.title: YAMAURA MARU at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports YAMAURA MARU’s arrival and onward route.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Buenos Aires and was due to sail through Santos, Curaçao and the Panama Canal to Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: YAMAURA MARU departs Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports YAMAURA MARU’s departure for Kobe via American and Pacific ports.
subfiles.summary: The vessel departed December 23 after arriving December 17.

subfiles.title: YAMAURA MARU report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenos Aires report on YAMAURA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Lists its December 23 departure and planned route to Kobe.

subfiles.title: HIE MARU at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports HIE MARU proceeding from Buenaventura to Callao.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese steamship arrived from Balboa and departed for Callao.

subfiles.title: GINYO MARU movement
subfiles.about: Reports GINYO MARU’s arrival and planned voyage to Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived December 22 from Arica and was to depart December 24 via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Melbourne vessel departure
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese vessel sailing toward Manila.
subfiles.summary: The vessel’s name is illegible; its route includes Sydney, Brisbane and Thursday Island.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports NORWAY MARU at Callao, bound for Valparaíso.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived December 25 from Balboa and was expected to sail via Mollendo.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU paraphrase for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Summarizes the Lima telegram on NORWAY MARU.
subfiles.summary: Notes its arrival from Balboa and expected departure for Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU second paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the same NORWAY MARU movement report.
subfiles.summary: Adds the vessel’s stated net tonnage of 4,229 tons.

subfiles.title: ANYO MARU departs Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports ANYO MARU sailing to Karachi and its projected route to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The ship left Bombay December 26 and was expected to leave Karachi December 31.

subfiles.title: ANYO MARU report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Bombay sailing report for ANYO MARU.
subfiles.summary: Summarizes its Bombay departure and expected voyage from Karachi to Kobe.

subfiles.title: Corrected Singapore vessel report
subfiles.about: Corrects a report on MURORAN MARU, MILAN MARU and BATUPAHAT.
subfiles.summary: Lists their Singapore and Johor arrival or departure times.

subfiles.title: Original Singapore vessel report
subfiles.about: Reports movements of MURORAN MARU, MILAN MARU and BATUPAHAT.
subfiles.summary: An earlier version of the report contains uncertain vessel and place readings.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission slip
subfiles.about: Provides instructions for transmitting and recording a Navy message.
subfiles.summary: Printer transmission form with a handwritten request to identify the message’s date and origin.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel movements for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the corrected Singapore report on three vessels.
subfiles.summary: Gives movements of MILAN MARU, BATUPAHAT and MURORAN MARU.

subfiles.title: Puntarenas reporting procedure
subfiles.about: Requests guidance on reporting Japanese ships sailing from Puntarenas to Balboa.
subfiles.summary: Hornibrook describes arrangements to collect vessel information and cites NORWAY MARU as an example. He proposes notifying the Fifteenth Naval District directly when a ship leaves Puntarenas for Balboa.

subfiles.title: Puntarenas proposal referred to Navy
subfiles.to: A. H. McCollum, Office of Naval Intelligence
subfiles.about: Forwards Hornibrook’s proposed Puntarenas reporting procedure for Navy consideration.
subfiles.summary: The liaison officer encloses the San José despatch and recalls the Navy’s request for Japanese vessel movement reports.

subfiles.title: Approval of direct Puntarenas reporting
subfiles.about: Approves direct reports to the Fifteenth Naval District for ships sailing to Balboa.
subfiles.summary: The minister is also asked to send the same information to the Department of State.

subfiles.title: HIE MARU at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports HIE MARU arriving at Callao and sailing south.
subfiles.summary: The passenger ship arrived December 27 and was to sail for Mollendo, Arica and Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: HIE MARU telegram copy
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Lima report on HIE MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the ship’s arrival and planned southbound route.

subfiles.title: Three Japanese vessels at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports movements of VENICE MARU, TAKAOKA MARU and GINYO MARU.
subfiles.summary: Provides arrival, departure and destination details for three Japanese vessels.

subfiles.title: LISBON MARU at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports LISBON MARU arriving from Rangoon and departing for Shanghai.
subfiles.summary: Intermediate ports were unknown.

subfiles.title: Navy preference on vessel tonnage
subfiles.about: Records the Navy’s request for reports on Japanese vessels between 3,500 and 4,000 tons.
subfiles.summary: Memorandum of a telephone call with Commander McCollum.

subfiles.title: Singapore advance sailing schedule
subfiles.about: Provides expected Japanese ship arrivals and sailings and asks about the tonnage threshold.
subfiles.summary: Patton lists projected Singapore calls by several vessels, with actual sailing dates to follow. He asks whether reports are wanted for tramp steamers between 3,500 and 4,000 tons.

subfiles.title: Reply on Singapore reporting
subfiles.about: Directs reporting of imminent or actual departures, including vessels between 3,500 and 4,000 tons.
subfiles.summary: The Department declines telegraphed schedules but confirms the lower tonnage range is of interest.

subfiles.title: MONTEVIDEO at La Guaira
subfiles.about: Reports the Japanese steamship MONTEVIDEO’s arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Cristóbal and sailed toward Buenos Aires via Brazilian and Uruguayan ports.

subfiles.title: MONTEVIDEO report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the La Guaira report on MONTEVIDEO.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the ship’s December 30 arrival and route to Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Confidential filing note
subfiles.about: Records confidential filing of the preceding material.
subfiles.summary: Marked “filed in the confidential files.”

subfiles.title: Charge slip
subfiles.about: Tracks removal or handling of a file.
subfiles.summary: Mostly blank charge form with illegible handwritten entries.

subfiles.title: ARIMA MARU at Barranquilla
subfiles.about: Reports ARIMA MARU arriving from Cristóbal and bound for New York.
subfiles.summary: The vessel planned to depart December 31 via Curaçao and La Guaira.

subfiles.title: ARIMA MARU report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Barranquilla report on ARIMA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival from Cristóbal and planned route to New York.

subfiles.title: ASOS MARU at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports ASOS MARU’s arrival from Iloilo and planned voyage to New York.
subfiles.summary: The vessel was to leave December 31 via Kobe and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: ASOS MARU report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Singapore report on ASOS MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival and planned voyage to New York.

subfiles.title: MELBOURNE MARU at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports MELBOURNE MARU’s departure for Colombo.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Hong Kong December 31 and sailed January 1.

subfiles.title: MELBOURNE MARU report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Singapore report on MELBOURNE MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its December 31 arrival and January 1 sailing.

subfiles.title: NAGATO MARU at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports NAGATO MARU arriving from Penang.
subfiles.summary: The telegram appears to misprint January 2 as July 2.

subfiles.title: NAGATO MARU report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays NAGATO MARU’s Singapore arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Notes the uncertain date and says the ship left for Hong Kong.

subfiles.title: YAMAURA MARU departs Santos
subfiles.about: Reports YAMAURA MARU leaving Santos for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived December 27 from Montevideo and sailed December 31 via Curaçao, Panama and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: ARIMA MARU at Curaçao
subfiles.about: Reports ARIMA MARU arriving from Barranquilla and departing for New York.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived January 1 and left January 2 via La Guaira.

subfiles.title: ARIMA MARU Curaçao report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Curaçao report on ARIMA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its January 1 arrival and January 2 departure.

subfiles.title: HAVANA MARU departs Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports HAVANA MARU sailing toward Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The ship left Bombay December 31, with calls scheduled at Singapore and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: HAVANA MARU report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Bombay report on HAVANA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the departure and expected intermediate calls.

subfiles.title: SEIA MARU departs Santos
subfiles.about: Reports SEIA MARU sailing from Santos to Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived December 31 from Rio de Janeiro and departed on the report date.

subfiles.title: SEIA MARU copy for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Repeats the Santos report on SEIA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Records its December 31 arrival and January 3 departure.

subfiles.title: KURAMA MARU at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports KURAMA MARU leaving Buenos Aires for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived December 28 and sailed January 3 via the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: KURAMA MARU report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenos Aires report on KURAMA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival, departure and destination.

subfiles.title: TAKAOKA MARU at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports TAKAOKA MARU’s arrival and planned departure for Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Coquimbo December 31 and was due to sail January 5 via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: TAKAOKA MARU report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Valparaíso report on TAKAOKA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival and planned route to Hong Kong.

subfiles.title: ARIMA at La Guaira
subfiles.about: Reports ARIMA’s arrival and departure for New York.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived January 3 and cleared January 4.

subfiles.title: ARIMA report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the La Guaira report on ARIMA.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival from Panama and departure for New York.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports NORWAY MARU sailing to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Arica January 3 and sailed January 6 via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Valparaíso report on NORWAY MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival and route to Kobe.

subfiles.title: HIE MARU at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports HIE MARU’s departure for Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Arica January 3 and sailed January 6 via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: HIE MARU report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Valparaíso report on HIE MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival from Arica and sailing for Hong Kong.

subfiles.title: Singapore reports three vessels
subfiles.about: Reports recent movements of KASIMA MARU, ATLAS MARU and TOA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Lists each vessel’s Singapore arrival, departure and onward route.

subfiles.title: KIYOKAWA MARU at Puntarenas
subfiles.about: Reports KIYOKAWA MARU’s arrival and planned voyage south.
subfiles.summary: The damaged text lists Balboa, Guayaquil, Callao, Mollendo, Arica and Valparaíso as onward ports.

subfiles.title: KIYOKAWA MARU report for Navy and Coast Guard
subfiles.about: Relays the San José report on KIYOKAWA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Places its arrival from Manzanillo at Puntarenas and lists its planned southbound calls.

subfiles.title: Handwritten file annotation
subfiles.about: Contains an informal filing instruction or comment.
subfiles.summary: Handwriting is largely illegible; the second page appears to instruct someone to file the material.

subfiles.title: Montevideo reports KURAMA MARU and SEIA MARU
subfiles.about: Reports two vessel movements and asks whether consular cables should continue.
subfiles.summary: KURAMA MARU sailed for Yokohama; SEIA MARU sailed for Los Angeles via South American ports and Panama. Wilson asks whether the naval attaché’s separate reports supersede the legation’s.

subfiles.title: Montevideo vessel report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the vessel movements from Montevideo.
subfiles.summary: Summarizes SEIA MARU’s route and KURAMA MARU’s departure; omits the reporting question.

subfiles.title: Circular instructions on Japanese vessel reporting
subfiles.to: Chiefs of American diplomatic missions in the American republics except Panama and La Paz
subfiles.about: Sets the information consuls should telegraph about Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Calls for confidential reports on Japanese naval ships and merchant ships of at least 4,000 gross tons.

subfiles.title: KIYOKAWA MARU at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Repeats Vice Consul Hoyt’s report on KIYOKAWA MARU.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived January 3 from Los Angeles, unloaded Japanese cargo and planned to sail for Puntarenas.

subfiles.title: KIYOKAWA MARU report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Hoyt’s Manzanillo report on KIYOKAWA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival, 200-ton cargo discharge and expected departure.

subfiles.title: Handwritten note on Navy reporting
subfiles.about: Comments on apparent confusion about ship reporting.
subfiles.summary: A largely illegible handwritten note mentions the Navy Department and ship reports.

subfiles.title: Lima inquiry on duplicate ship reporting
subfiles.about: Asks whether consular reports should continue after new naval attaché instructions.
subfiles.summary: McGurk says the naval attaché must report movements twice weekly for most vessels over 2,000 tons. Because his mission is Peru’s only consular office with a confidential code, he asks whether it should continue the December 17 reporting procedure.

subfiles.title: Reply to Montevideo on continuing reports
subfiles.about: Directs continued consular cables on Japanese vessel movements.
subfiles.summary: The Navy considers naval attaché reports supplementary to the legation’s reports.

subfiles.title: Reply to Lima on continuing reports
subfiles.about: Directs continued consular cables on Japanese vessel movements.
subfiles.summary: The Navy considers naval attaché reports supplementary to the embassy’s reports.
